facts.business: EMS Limited is engaged in the business of sewerage solutions, water supply systems, water and waste treatment plants, electrical transmission and distribution, road and allied works, and operation and maintenance of water and wastewater treatment plants for government authorities.

auditor.name: Ajay Kumar Kapoor & Company, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Technological obsolescence due to rapid advancement of technology reducing lifecycle of current solutions
Delay in completion of projects due to change in government and shifting priorities
Climate change leading to more frequent and severe weather events overwhelming sewerage systems
Groundwater depletion and over-exploitation affecting water supply sources
Infrastructure financing challenges related to cost of capital, project structuring, and delayed payments in PPP frameworks
Credit risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk, exchange risk, and commodity price risk
facts.related_party_note: Advances to related parties outstanding as on March 31, 2026: Mirzapur Ghazipur STPs Private Limited (Rs 4,200.32 lakhs), Canary Infrastructure Private Limited (Rs 286.00 lakhs), EMS Industries (formerly BrijBihari Pulp and Paper Private Limited) (Rs 8,855.27 lakhs).
